title: pm-dispatch: one checklist card per reviewed PR for its review follow-ups, p3 copy nits into area loose-ends cards, a dedupe step, and the 24h flow line
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XSd2LdkGDq79ihifNMPq7ZQ)_

domain:skills#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5nz1BoBSawC99X5UqM

Fixes #33718

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:复审的后续事项改成每个 PR 一张清单卡(标题 `review follow-ups of PR #N`,后来的 delta 或追溯复审往里追加);p3 文案和文档小问题并进该区已有的 loose ends 卡;复审立卡前先按 PR 号和文件路径查重,同一发现就追加;代码 PR 欠的 skills/ADR 文本改成每个 PR 一张卡;分诊轮次记录每 3 小时报一次 24 小时的开卡、关卡、净变、合并 PR 数、open p1 和引契约复审的新卡数。
- 为什么改:维护者 2026-11-15 选了 B(「b」,记录 6891082225):复审默认做法不变,只改后续事项变成卡的形态,减少一个 PR 拆出多张卡和重复卡。
- 风险与回滚:只动三份 pm-dispatch 参考文件和行数棘轮的两行上限;「仅 nit 即终轮」的默认、每个缺陷一张卡的配额行、队列守卫都没动。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/filing-gate.md` 新增的三行(配额行之后);`references/triage-duties.md` 第 16 行和第 74 行;`references/contract-review.md` 第 41-42 行和第 57 行。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`,预期全部 ✓,filing-gate.md 82 行(上限 82)、triage-duties.md 104 行(上限 104)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地(Tier S)。

## What changes

All four items of the card's "What lands", under ruling B (record 6891082225, the maintainer's 「b」, 2026-11-15). The review default is unchanged.

- **`references/filing-gate.md`, three lines after the quota line (one home for items 1 to 3).**
  - Item 1: review follow-ups (nits, accepted deviations, same-lane findings outside the diff) go into one card per reviewed PR, titled `review follow-ups of PR #N`, ticked item by item; a later review of the same PR appends and files nothing new.
  - Item 2: a p3 copy or docs nit goes into the area's `AREA loose ends` card, and one is opened only when none exists.
  - Item 3: before a review files, it searches open cards for `PR #N` and the file path, and appends a repeat of the same finding.
  - The quota line (one card per defect, #25687) is untouched, and the exception says so in place (「① 缺陷仍各立」): a real gate ① defect found outside the diff keeps its own card and is not a tick item. The dedupe step merges only repeats of the same finding.
- **`references/contract-review.md`, two in-place edits (0 lines).** The nit clause now sends nits to the PR's follow-up card (「转 PR 后续卡」), which points to the filing rule. The landed-head must-fix line says 「立卡」 instead of 「立新卡」, so a search hit on the same finding is appended rather than filed again. One character (「才」) moved from L42 to L41 to keep both lines within 120 bytes.
- **`references/contract-review.md` L51, carried for #33604 (PR #33736), in place (0 lines):** the landing pre-check's ① now reads 「现 head 同形达档 PASS 在案,无前两级」, matching #33736's queue guard, which refuses a same-head PASS that still lists an open must-fix or should-fix. To fit 120 bytes, 「过则 Tier S 入队、Tier H 等人批」 became 「过则 S 入队、H 等人批」 (the tier letters in the same sentence).
- **`references/triage-duties.md`.**
  - L74, the 11-11 carve-out (ruling 6797014134), changed in place: skills/ADR text owed by a code PR is now one `domain:skills` card per PR, not one per finding.
  - L16, new: the round record states the 24h flow every 3 hours (issues created, closed, net; PRs merged; open p1; new cards citing a contract review). The card says the triage patrol prompt already carries this. No rule text did, and a patrol routine is deleted when its seat goes off duty (`seat-lifecycle.md`), so the rule text is the durable home.
- **`scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`, two CEILINGS rows.** An ordinary ruled raise under the ratchet header's rule (ruling 6184799323): the ruling of record that orders this text is **6891082225**. Measured deltas: `filing-gate.md` **79 → 82 (+3)**, `triage-duties.md` **103 → 104 (+1)**. Each row moves by exactly its delta, with a comment that names the ruling. Neither file has a whole line that restates another file, so paying by deletion would have dropped a live rule. The dispatch order first said not to raise. The seat then ruled raise A for both files, citing this ruling.

## Tests

No test file changes. The ratchet script's own self-test was run because the diff edits its CEILINGS map (results under Verification).

## Acceptance notes

- **Review round 1 (at-tier PASS with S1):** S1 fixed at `afffd197`: filing-gate.md L35-36 now states that a ① defect keeps its own card, with no new line (「接受的偏差」 to 「接受偏差」, 「合一卡」 to 「一卡」, 「后轮复核」 to 「后轮」 paid the bytes). N2 (point contract-review.md L42 at filing-gate.md) was not taken: L41 and L42 both sit at 120 bytes, and the pointer would cost about 7 bytes of rule content. N3 and N4 were accepted as they are. The L51 carry for #33604 landed at `51787fa6` and is part of the same delta review.

- **Out of surface, carried elsewhere:** `references/landing-operations.md` L13 (a retro review's findings 「立新卡」 to 「发现照立卡门入卡」) is in PR #33732's diff (#33647 PR 2). #33732 also edits `check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` on other rows; whichever lands second merges `origin/main`.
- **Reading chosen:** the per-PR checklist card carries what the card's item 1 lists (nits, accepted deviations, same-lane findings outside the diff). A must-fix on a landed head stays one card per finding, graded by finding (contract-review.md L57), and is deduped by the same search. That keeps item 3's 「the per-defect rule still holds for real defects」.
- **Not added:** the card mentions spec wording next to skills/ADR in the carve-out. The 11-11 ruling covers ADR and skills text only, so L74 names those two. Adding spec would widen that ruling.
- **Execution-time carve-out untouched:** `execution-duties.md` L110 (an implementation card's file surface excludes ADR/skills paths, 「各立 `domain:skills` 卡」) is the dispatch-time split, not a review follow-up, and stays as is.
- **No gate or recogniser checks the follow-up filing shape:** `grep` over `scripts/` and `.github/` for 「转后续卡」, 「立新卡」, 「折清单卡」, 「携带注记」, `follow-ups of PR` and `loose ends` finds no hit, so no recogniser or lint pins the old text and no gate was added.
- Serial note: #33716 (contract-review.md) waits for this PR.

## Verification

On head `afffd197` (the full derived list; `51787fa6` changes only contract-review.md L51, and its re-run subset is listed at the end of this section) (branch `claude/project-thread-7lnz38`, merge base `origin/main` `48e69596`), each exit code captured before any pipe:

- `node scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`: exit 0. `filing-gate.md` 82 lines (ceiling 82), `triage-duties.md` 104 (ceiling 104), `contract-review.md` 63 (ceiling 63); no line over 120 bytes.
- `node scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs --self-test`: exit 0, 「164 cases pass」.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --tier`: **no path-derived mandate** (the surface hits none of the 4 declared globs); 29 changed lines, under the 3000 threshold.
- `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --branch HEAD`: **GOVERNED, Tier S** (`.claude/**` x3; `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` not on the register). The owning seat lands it after an at-tier contract review PASS on the current head.
- Derived gates (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`, 40 families, after `pnpm --filter "@objectstack/lint..." build` under the lock, exit 0): all 40 exit 0. `--ran`: 「40 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 40 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED」.
